description: This file defines the view class for displaying email details within SuiteCRM. It extends the base ViewDetail class, manages the display preparation, and updates email status upon viewing.

classes.name: EmailsViewDetail
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail that manages the email detail view, including pre-display setup and status updates.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the email detail view by initializing the EmailsDetailView object and populating it with request data.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic of the email detail view and updates the email's read/unread status.
